```{r setup, include=FALSE}
set.seed(275951)
M <- 1000
n <- 20
m <- 20
alpha <- 0.05
delta <- c(0, 0.2, 0.4, 0.6, 0.8, 1)
```


```{r}
zapisw <- c()
zapist <- c()
for (i in delta){
  countw <- 0
  countt <- 0
  for (j in 1:M){
    x <- rnorm(n)
    y <- rnorm(m, i)
    
    w <- wilcox.test(x,y,alternative="less",exact=FALSE,correct=FALSE)
    t <- t.test(x,y,alternative="less",var.equal = TRUE)
    
    if (w$p.value < alpha){countw <- countw + 1}
    if (t$p.value < alpha){countt <- countt + 1}
  }
  zapist <- c(zapist, countt / M)
  zapisw <- c(zapisw, countw / M)
}
```

```{r}
cat("delta Moc testu Wilcoxona Moc testu t-Studenta Lepszy test\n")
for (i in 1:6){
  lepszy <- ""
  if(zapist[i] < zapisw[i]){
    lepszy <- "W"
  }
  else{lepszy <- "T"}
  cat(zapist[i]," ",zapisw[i]," ",lepszy ,"\n")
}
```


```{r}
plot(delta, zapisw, type = "l")
lines(delta, zapist, col="red")
```


```{r}
P95 <-function(){rbinom(m,1,0.95)}
P90 <-function(){rbinom(m,1,0.90)}
N05 <-function(){rnorm(m,0.5,1)}
N8 <-function(){rnorm(m,8,1)}
N12 <-function(){rnorm(m,12,1)}
N20 <-function(){rnorm(m,20,1)}
```



```{r}
zapisw2 <- c()
zapist2 <- c()

countw <- 0
countt <- 0
for (j in 1:M){
  x <- rnorm(n)
  y <- rnorm(m, 0.5)
  
  w <- wilcox.test(x,y,alternative="less",exact=FALSE,correct=FALSE)
  t <- t.test(x,y,alternative="less",var.equal = TRUE)
  
  if (w$p.value < alpha){countw <- countw + 1}
  if (t$p.value < alpha){countt <- countt + 1}
}
zapist2 <- c(zapist2, countt / M)
zapisw2 <- c(zapisw2, countw / M)
```


```{r}
countw <- 0
countt <- 0
for (j in 1:M){
  x <- rnorm(n)
  temp <- P95()
  y <- temp*N05() + (1-temp)*N8()
  
  w <- wilcox.test(x,y,alternative="less",exact=FALSE,correct=FALSE)
  t <- t.test(x,y,alternative="less",var.equal = TRUE)
  
  if (w$p.value < alpha){countw <- countw + 1}
  if (t$p.value < alpha){countt <- countt + 1}
}
zapist2 <- c(zapist2, countt / M)
zapisw2 <- c(zapisw2, countw / M)
```

```{r}

  countw <- 0
  countt <- 0
```

```{r}
    x <- rt(n, df=3)
    y <- rt(m, df=3) + i

    t <- t.test(x,y,alternative="less",var.equal = TRUE)

    if (t$p.value < alpha){countt <- countt + 1}
  }
  zapist <- c(zapist, countt / M)
  zapisw <- c(zapisw, countw / M)
}
```

